systems.owner: Civil Registry Department, Ministry of Home Affairs
systems.tiers: national, by mobile teams, 1 February to 30 September 2022; 1,804,256 birth certificates, 1,345,719 national identity documents and 53,414 death certificates issued; a mop-up exercise planned before the 2023 elections

note: The minister's statement to Parliament on a fixed-term mobile registration exercise: a campaign, not an office; the article does not say how the records were made.
